defense_news.title: US military must focus on ‘right mix’ of weapons amid stockpile concerns: Official
defense_news.summary: With lingering questions regarding the depleted U.S. stockpiles due to the war with Iran, the U.S. military is looking to build the “right mix” of weapons.

defense_news.title: Lockheed to build 4 more Vectis drones, 2027 first flight remains on target
defense_news.summary: Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works is slated to build four more Vectis uncrewed aircraft, with the first expected to fly by the end of 2027.

defense_news.title: Geissele Automatics reveals ‘production-ready’ assault rifle for SOCOM

defense_news.title: US Air Force to stand up point defense career field within 2 years, Wilsbach says
defense_news.summary: Within two years, the Air Force will establish a new career field focused on defending American air bases worldwide.
